nodes.label: SLOOP Icon (SVG)
nodes.description: 240x240 vector master of the icon mark: open arc, mast rect, four sail polygons in #287CFF/#1ECC70/#FFC618/#FF621A, hull bar; #F2F2F2 strokes on #000.

nodes.label: SLOOP Brand Identity
nodes.description: Sailboat ('sloop') mark whose sail is a 4-step colored level meter (blue/green/yellow/orange) inside an open gauge ring; light-grey #F2F2F2 monoline geometry on black; lowercase rounded 'sloop' wordmark.
nodes.rationale: Pun on the name: a sloop sailboat whose sail doubles as a VU/level meter, signalling an audio looper; black background with high-contrast monoline suits small device displays and app icons.
